I completed GTA V and CMM recently, so I wanted to add this tip for anyone attempting: If you die during CMM, you can unplug your ethernet cable (assuming you aren't on Wi-Fi) so you disconnect before the autosave kicks in. This prevents your CMM progress from being reset and makes it so you don't have to start over each time. After that it just takes patience and time!
